title: Renewing access to supporting conditions
user_request: lets explore this stronger working formulation
interpretation: Make access to support endogenous; distinguish continued renewal from preservation of a material form; retain the coupled situation as the explanatory unit.
continuity: Conditions-of-generativity supplied usable power; this extension makes its capture depend on maintained machinery.
Earlier identity and missing-possibility work motivates the distinction between an adequate aggregate for one function and omitted consequential functions.
All earlier outputs are retained unchanged.

claim_status.capture_budget: Exact reduced model with Pcaptured=eta I C/M <= I; full molecular thermodynamics not derived.
claim_status.equilibrium_fold: Proved existence of two positive equilibria above gf=epsilon b+4s ell b/(kM^2), one double equilibrium at gf, none below.
claim_status.bistability: Proved local asymptotic stability of inactivity at every finite g and of the upper positive branch above gf. Lower branch is a saddle.
claim_status.global_scope: No complete basin boundary or classification of nonstationary attractors. Fold is not asserted as a global survival threshold.
claim_status.small_preparation_failure: Proved invariant region and convergence to inactive equilibrium; exact unit-parameter certificate at g17, R0=.01, C0=E0=0, D0=.99.
claim_status.formation: Exact initial machinery formation and second derivative of captured reserve from R0>0; long-term activation from R0=1 is illustrated numerically.
claim_status.succession: Exact X-to-Y replacement at fixed aggregate equilibrium; a supplied Y-only channel activates finite substrate conversion.
claim_status.novelty_scope: Newly accessible function in a stipulated repertoire; no derived invention of chemistry or open-ended novelty.
claim_status.universal_direction: No universal increase of generativity or direction toward kindness proved; wider environmental effects remain to be modeled.
